properties.displayName: Deny Azure RBAC role assignments made directly to users
properties.description: Role assignments must target groups, service principals or managed identities. Direct user assignments bypass group-based access reviews and are left behind when people change teams. Listed principal object IDs (break-glass accounts) are exempt.

metadata.description: Start with Audit, move to Deny once the compliance report is clean.
Object IDs of users that may still receive direct assignments, e.g. emergency access accounts.
